verdict.rationale: Khoj clearly supports bringing your own API keys/models via LiteLLM, Ollama, or direct OpenAI-compatible configs, letting self-hosters plug in any LLM (khoj-docs-9, khoj-docs-10, khoj-gh-2, khoj-docs-41). However, there is no evidence of any token usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation anywhere in the docs or community discussion. Missing for 10: usage/cost dashboards or logs, per-conversation or per-model cost breakdown, any admin panel metrics showing spend.
